post.description: Public: no authentication required. Creates the account and logs the user in.

Public: no authentication required. Starts a new session for the account.

The right password on a deactivated account reactivates it (`reactivated: true`).
Ends only the session of the cookie that was sent.

delete.description: Deletes the account (soft delete) and logs out every device. Requires login, not consent.

post.description: Records consent to storing health data. Requires login, not consent.
Records that the first-run introduction was closed. Requires login, not consent.

Deactivates the account (no data deleted) and logs out every device.

Requires login, not consent. Logging in again with the right password reactivates it.

get.description: The user's profile and stored daily target; 404 `profile_not_found` before setup.

put.description: Create or replace the profile; the target is recomputed and stored on every save.

get.description: Shared items plus the user's own whose name contains `q`; max 20; `[]` under 2 chars.

post.description: Register the user's own food item (`source="user"`); only its owner can see it.

get.description:
The user's 10 most recently logged distinct items, newest first (by entry `date`,
then `created_at`), each with the last grams and Meal.

Find a food by EAN-8/13: the user's own items, then shared items, then Open Food
Facts (a found product is cached as a shared item). Only called on submit.
The user's entries for one date (YYYY-MM-DD) by Meal, with Meal and day totals.

post.description: Log grams of a food item in a Meal; kcal per 100 g is copied as a snapshot.

patch.description: Change grams and/or Meal of the user's entry; the date and kcal snapshot never change.

delete.description: Delete the user's entry at once; it can be restored for 10 minutes.

post.description: Undo a delete made within the last 10 minutes ("Angre"); otherwise 404.

get.description: The nine equipment types in seed order.

Exercises whose required equipment is all in the user's chosen Equipment Profile,
ordered Nybegynner, Middels, Øvet. Optional filters: `muscle_group` (primary or
secondary) and `level`; an unknown value is a 422 field error. Another user's profile,
or an id that is unknown or not a UUID, is 404 `equipment_profile_not_found`.

Every exercise whose name contains `q` (case-insensitive; `q` trimmed, 2–50
characters, else 422 on `q`), each with whether it fits the user's chosen Equipment
Profile and which equipment is missing. Fitting first, then level, muscle group, name.
Another user's profile, or an unknown or non-UUID id, is 404.

The user's Equipment Profiles in creation order. A user with none (registered before
profiles existed) gets "Hjemme" and "Treningssenter" first.

post.description: New profile; Kroppsvekt is always included. At most 10 profiles, names unique.

patch.description: Rename and/or replace the equipment of the user's profile; Kroppsvekt is kept.

delete.description: Delete the user's profile; the last one cannot be deleted.

get.description: All exercises, ordered by primary muscle group, then name.

One exercise with muscle groups, equipment, technique steps and video id. An id that
is unknown or not a UUID is 404 `exercise_not_found`.
The user's workout in progress, or `{"workout": null}`.
The user's finished workouts, newest date first (then newest created).

post.description:
Start an empty workout for `date` (201), or return the one already in progress
unchanged, date included (200).

get.description: One of the user's workouts with its exercises in order.

delete.description: Delete a workout (finished or not) with its exercises and sets. Cannot be undone.

post.description: Mark the workout finished. Already finished is 409.

Add an exercise last with three empty sets. Each exercise once (409), at most 20
(422). Only into an unfinished workout (finished is 404).

put.description: Save a new order; `ids` must be exactly the workout's workout exercise ids (422).

delete.description: Remove one exercise from the workout; the others keep their order.

post.description: Add a set to an exercise, last or at `position`. At most 20 sets per exercise.

patch.description: Change reps, kg, seconds or done; null clears a value.

delete.description: Delete a set; the others keep their order.

get.description:
Target, kcal eaten and remaining, the Meals and the done workouts for one date
(YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only; a date more than one day after today is 422.

Monday to Sunday from `start` (a Monday, YYYY-MM-DD): whether food and a workout with
a done set were logged each day, and whether the day is after today (Europe/Oslo).

ActiveWorkoutResponse.title: ActiveWorkoutResponse
ActiveWorkoutResponse.description: The workout in progress, or null when there is none.

EquipmentProfileCreate.title: EquipmentProfileCreate
EquipmentProfileCreate.description: A new profile. `kroppsvekt` is always added by the server, whatever is sent.

EquipmentProfileUpdate.title: EquipmentProfileUpdate
EquipmentProfileUpdate.description:
Rename and/or replace the equipment. Left out or null means unchanged; `kroppsvekt`
is always kept.

ExerciseSearchItem.title: ExerciseSearchItem
ExerciseSearchItem.description:
A search result (story 4.4): the list item plus whether it fits the chosen profile
and, if not, the missing equipment (Norwegian names, seed order).

ExerciseSearchResponse.title: ExerciseSearchResponse
ExerciseSearchResponse.description:
Exercises whose name contains the query, fitting ones first, then Nybegynner,
Middels, Øvet, muscle group and name.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One invalid input field, shown inline under that field in the UI.

FoodEntryUpdate.title: FoodEntryUpdate
FoodEntryUpdate.description:
Change grams and/or Meal of an entry (story 3.6). Left out or null means unchanged;
the item, date and kcal snapshot can never be changed (AD-6).

FoodItemCreate.title: FoodItemCreate
FoodItemCreate.description:
A user's own food item. `source` and `owner_id` are set by the server; extra keys
such as those are ignored (AD-4).

LastTimeResponse.title: LastTimeResponse
LastTimeResponse.description: The done sets of this exercise in the user's latest earlier workout (story 5.3).

LastTimeSet.title: LastTimeSet
LastTimeSet.description: One done set from last time (story 5.3).

MuscleGroupSlug.title: MuscleGroupSlug
MuscleGroupSlug.description: The six muscle groups of the seed (story 4.1), used to filter suggestions (4.5).

RecentFoodResponse.title: RecentFoodResponse
RecentFoodResponse.description: A food item the user logged before, with the amount and Meal of its latest entry.

SetCreate.title: SetCreate
SetCreate.description:
A new set (story 5.2). Values are optional (an empty set is fine); `position` is
0-based and puts the set there (used by "Angre"); without it the set is added last.

SetUpdate.title: SetUpdate
SetUpdate.description:
Change a set. A left-out field is unchanged; null clears `reps`, `weight_kg` or
`seconds` (null `done` is unchanged).

SuggestionsResponse.title: SuggestionsResponse
SuggestionsResponse.description:
Exercises that fit one Equipment Profile (story 4.3), ordered Nybegynner, Middels,
Øvet, then muscle group, then name.

WeekDayResponse.title: WeekDayResponse
WeekDayResponse.description: One day in the week strip (story 6.3).

WorkoutCreate.title: WorkoutCreate
WorkoutCreate.description: Start a workout on this calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Oslo, AD-12).

WorkoutExerciseAdd.title: WorkoutExerciseAdd
WorkoutExerciseAdd.description: The exercise to add last. An id that is unknown or not a UUID is 404.

WorkoutExerciseOrder.title: WorkoutExerciseOrder
WorkoutExerciseOrder.description: Every workout exercise id of the workout, exactly once, in the new order.
